extras: Installation requires manual steps (download, extract, rename) as it is not a standard marketplace plugin.
intentEvidence: A powerful Obsidian plugin for cleaning Markdown formatting and intelligently converting mathematical formulas.
problem: Users often encounter messy Markdown formatting from copied content and need a reliable way to convert LaTeX math formulas into standard Obsidian syntax.
summary: A plugin that cleans excess Markdown formatting symbols and intelligently converts LaTeX mathematical formulas to standard Obsidian syntax.
